Its parent is Yuxing InfoTech, based in Shenzhen and listed in Hong Kong. Its CEO, Cong Yu, holds a degree from a People’s Liberation Army military college. RiCloud got partner status about 10 weeks after it was incorporated. Aivres is an Nvidia “elite” partner, the top tier. It was formerly called Inspur, after its Chinese parent, which the US blacklisted in 2023, and changed its name afterward. Citing an NYT analysis, CBS reports Aivres exported at least $5.6 billion in advanced technology to Southeast Asia, including about $3 billion in Blackwell-equipped computers. Some went to Megaspeed, the firm linked to Alice Huang, which provided AI cloud services to Alibaba and ByteDance. tweet

Location: Kunda, Pratapgarh, Uttar Pradesh Date: November 18 At a Shri Ram Katha organised by MLA Raghuraj Pratap Singh, leader of Jansatta Dal (Loktantrik), monk Karshni Nagendra Maharaj described India as the land of Ram, Krishna and rishis, claiming that Aurangzeb and Babur looted Hindu temples and constructed domes over them. He alleged a conspiracy to turn India into an "Islamic country" and urged Hindus to take up both "shaastra" (scripture) and "shastra" (weapons). He claimed priests were being targeted for opposing this agenda and warned that Hindus would no longer tolerate insults to Hindu deities and priests. Far-right speaker Pushpendra Kulshreshtha asserted the supremacy and permanence of Sanatan Dharma, dismissing the idea that all religions are equal and declaring that “your bloodline will perish, but Sanatan will not,” as mazhabs (religions) come and die while Dharma endures. He further questioned why government collected offerings from Hindu temples while churches and mazars retained theirs.
